scene_description: Trial start. Incoming pedestrian on immediate left. Participant starts walking forward.
Pedestrian on immediate right from behind. Participant shifts slightly left but maintains forward movement.
Incoming pedestrian walking to right of participant. Participant shifts left but maintains forward movement.
Pedestrian passes participant on right. Incoming pedestrian on left. Participant shifts right but maintains forward movement.
Pedestrian on left passes participant. Participant moves forward despite two incoming pedestrians on left.

Pedestrian on left passes participant. Pair of incoming pedestrians ahead of participant. Right participant clearly walking to right of participant. Particopant shifts to left but maintains forward movement.
Gap appears between pair of incoming pedestrians. Right pedestrian closer to right of participant. Participant shifts rightward to enter gap.
Participant enters gap between incoming pedestrians.
Pedestrian suddenly appears on immediate right from behind participant. Participant shifts left to avoid collision.
Pedestrian on left heading to left of pedestrian. Pedestrian on right overtakes participant. Participant continues leftward shift while moving forward.
Pedestrian on left passes participant. Another incoming pedestrian on left. Participant moves forward and tandem follows pedestrian in front.
Pedestrian on right appears suddenly and is walking to right of participant. Participant rotates orientation leftward in collision avoidance measure.
Two pedestrians on left of participant and walking to left of participant. Participant maintains leftward orientation and visibly slows down.
